title: Packing Services in Long Beach | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Movers and packers in Long Beach for Craftsman bungalows, revival homes and downtown condos: kitchen-first packing, labeled cartons, sweeping-day planning.
heroSubtitle: Room-by-room packing for Long Beach bungalows, period-revival houses and downtown towers, with every carton marked for its new room

faq.question: Can the packers come on a Saturday or Sunday?
faq.answer: Yes. Our crews work Monday through Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, and a weekend visit also takes street sweeping off the table, since Long Beach enforces it only on weekdays. Check your building first, though: some condo associations, West Ocean among them, allow moves on weekdays only.

faq.question: My condo on Seaside Way books the elevator a week out. How do you plan packing around that?
faq.answer: We work backward from the elevator slot. Once management confirms the date, we send the $50 certificate of insurance and schedule packing for a weekday before the move, so the reserved hours go to loading rather than taping boxes. If your building lets packers use the elevator without a separate booking, packing and loading can happen on the same day.

faq.question: How long does it take to pack a bungalow or a California Heights house?
faq.answer: It depends on the number of rooms and how full the closets, cabinets and garage are, so we ask for a room list before quoting. A smaller home can often be packed in one visit; a large house usually needs a packing day before the move, which also keeps each day under the eight hours after which overtime starts. Every visit is billed hourly with a 3-hour minimum.

faq.question: What should I pull aside before the first box is taped?
faq.answer: Keep documents, passports, jewelry, medicine and family keepsakes with you; they should travel in your car. Perishables, hazardous materials, firearms and batteries are not packed for the truck, and house plants are better moved by you. Everything else in the home can be left for the crew.

faq.question: Is the wrap really free on a large house?
faq.answer: Yes. Every estimate includes tape and stretch wrap in whatever quantity the job takes, whether it is a studio downtown or a two-story house. Moving boxes in small, medium and large start at $4, and only the ones filled appear on the bill; premium paper and bubble wrap are available and priced in your estimate.
